SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Adds Zambia, Malawi or the DR Congo to Eastern Africa because they are near Kenya's neighbours.

example.question: Which country is in Eastern Africa?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child counts every country that is close, not the countries of the region.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "Zambia" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: Zambia is in Southern Africa. Rwanda is one of the countries of Eastern Africa.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Leaves out Ethiopia, Somalia, Djibouti or Eritrea as if the region ended at Kenya's borders.

example.question: Which list has only countries of Eastern Africa?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Ask for the countries on the Horn and ask whether they are east of Africa's middle.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: Ethiopia, Somalia, Djibouti and Eritrea are also in Eastern Africa. The region is bigger than the first countries a child learns.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Puts a North African or West African country (Egypt, Nigeria) in Eastern Africa.

example.question: Which one is NOT in Eastern Africa?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child places countries by their names, not the map.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "Burundi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Use the compass: Egypt is on the Mediterranean in the north, far from the East coast.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: Egypt is in North Africa. Burundi is in Eastern Africa.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Thinks Kenya is the largest country of Eastern Africa.

example.question: Which country is the largest in Eastern Africa?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child judges by the country he or she lives in.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "Kenya" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Give the areas in square kilometres and ask the child to compare the numbers.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: Ethiopia is about 1.1 million square kilometres. Kenya is about 580,000, so it is smaller.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Says every Eastern African country has a sea coast, or that Uganda has a coast.

example.question: Which country has no sea coast?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child thinks a big lake is a coast.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "Kenya" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Ask which ocean Uganda touches. Then trace where its ships must go to reach the sea.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: Uganda is landlocked. It has lakes but no sea coast. Kenya has a coast on the Indian Ocean.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Puts Tanzania north of Kenya or Somalia west of Kenya.

example.question: In which direction does Tanzania lie from Kenya?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child mixes the compass points.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "North" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Stand on Nairobi on a map and say which way Mombasa to Dar es Salaam runs.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: Tanzania lies to the south of Kenya. Uganda is west and Somalia is east.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Swaps latitudes and longitudes: says latitudes run from north to south.

example.question: Which lines run from east to west on a map?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child links the word long with the lines that look long from top to bottom.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "Longitudes" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Draw the equator and say it is a latitude; ask which way it runs.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: Latitudes run east to west. Longitudes run from the North Pole to the South Pole.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Says the equator is 0 degrees longitude or that the Prime Meridian is the equator.

example.question: Which line is 0 degrees latitude?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child remembers that both lines are 0 and swaps their names.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "The Prime Meridian" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Ask: which line cuts the earth into north and south? Then give it its name.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: The equator is 0 degrees latitude. The Prime Meridian is 0 degrees longitude.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Thinks latitude measures how far east or west a place is.

example.question: What does the latitude of a place tell you?
example.wrong_answer: How far east or west it is
example.correct_answer: How far north or south of the equator it is

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child has not tied a measure to each set of lines.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "How far east or west it is" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: Latitude tells how far north or south of the equator a place is. Longitude tells how far east or west of the Prime Meridian.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Reads 1 degree S as north of the equator because Nairobi is in Kenya, where the equator crosses.

example.question: Nairobi is at about 1 degree S. Which side of the equator is it?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child ignores the letter after the number.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "North of the equator" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Ask: what does S stand for? Mark the equator on a sketch and put 1 S below it.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: The letter S means south. Nairobi lies a little south of the equator.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Says every place in Eastern Africa is west of the Prime Meridian.

example.question: Kampala is at about 32 degrees E. Which side of the Prime Meridian is it?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child thinks Africa is west because it is far from Asia.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "West" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Read the E on the number and mark it on a sketch to the right of the 0 line.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: The letter E means east. All of Eastern Africa lies east of the Prime Meridian.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..error: Reads longitude before latitude when giving a position.

example.question: A place is written 4 N, 36 E. Which number is the latitude?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..cause: The child reads the numbers in the order he or she likes.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..reveals: Offer "36" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..help: Say the rule: latitude first (up and down), longitude second (across).
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..feedback: We give latitude first and longitude second, so 4 N is the latitude.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.POSITION_AND_SIZE_OF_COU..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..error: Thinks Lake Victoria belongs to Kenya only.

example.question: Which countries share Lake Victoria?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..cause: The child sees the Kenyan shore at Kisumu.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..reveals: Offer "Kenya only" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..help: Colour the three shores on a sketch in three colours.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..feedback: Lake Victoria is shared by Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania. It is the largest lake in Africa.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..error: Says all mountains in Eastern Africa are volcanic, including the Rwenzori.

example.question: How were the Rwenzori Mountains formed?
example.correct_answer: By land being pushed up between faults

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..error: Says a river carved the Great Rift Valley.

example.question: How was the Great Rift Valley formed?
example.wrong_answer: A river cut it out over time
example.correct_answer: The land between two faults dropped

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..reveals: Offer "A river cut it out over time" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..help: Draw a long block that slides down between two cracks.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..feedback: The Rift Valley formed when the land between faults dropped. A river did not cut it out.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..error: Says Lake Victoria lies inside the Rift Valley like Lake Turkana.

example.question: Which lake lies in a shallow bowl made by the land sagging between the two arms of the Rift?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..reveals: Offer "Lake Turkana" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..help: Mark both arms of the Rift on a sketch and ask where Victoria sits.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..feedback: Lake Victoria lies in a shallow bowl between two arms of the Rift. Lake Turkana lies in the Rift floor.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.MAIN_PHYSICAL_FEATURES_I..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..error: Thinks places on the equator are always wet and hot, so puts northern Kenya in the equatorial region.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..reveals: Offer "Equatorial" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..feedback: Northern Kenya is arid: very hot and very dry. The equatorial region is wet.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..error: Puts the highland region at the coast or beside the lakes.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..help: Ask what happens to temperature as we climb.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..feedback: The highland climate is found on high land such as Mount Kenya, Kilimanjaro and the Ethiopian Highlands.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..error: Says the arid region is cool and wet, or the equatorial region is dry.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..reveals: Offer "Cool with plenty of rain" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..help: Use a two-line table: rain and heat for each region.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..feedback: The arid region is very hot and very dry.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..error: Thinks high mountains near the equator are hotter than the plains.

example.question: Why is the top of Mount Kenya cold although it is on the equator?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..reveals: Offer "It is nearer the sun so it is hot" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..help: Use the fact that temperature falls with height; ask about the snow on Kilimanjaro.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..help: Ask what happens to tea in the dry north.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..feedback: Tea needs cool weather and plenty of rain, so it grows in the highlands.
SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.CLIMATIC_REGIONS_IN_EAST..error: Says drought causes floods, or heavy rain causes hunger by drought.

example.question: What does a long drought cause?

SOCI.G6.NATURA.VEGETATION_IN_EASTERN_AF..help: Ask which plants need the most water.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.VEGETATION_IN_EASTERN_AF..source: To confirm by a teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

SOCI.G6.NATURA.VEGETATION_IN_EASTERN_AF..error: Says savanna is thick forest with tall trees close together.
